message: fix(compat): validate generated registrants and platform symlinks; repair view tests
patch:
diff --git a/.github/workflows/piliplus-sdk-tests.yml b/.github/workflows/piliplus-sdk-tests.yml
index 80c480f..2e0cf69 100644
--- a/.github/workflows/piliplus-sdk-tests.yml
+++ b/.github/workflows/piliplus-sdk-tests.yml
@@ -34,4 +34,17 @@ jobs:
         run: flutter pub get
       - name: Full video regression (no weakening existing tests)
         working-directory: media_kit_video
-        run: flutter test --reporter expanded
+        shell: bash
+        run: |
+          set +e
+          flutter test --reporter expanded > "$RUNNER_TEMP/video-tests.log" 2>&1
+          status=$?
+          tail -n 100 "$RUNNER_TEMP/video-tests.log"
+          exit "$status"
+      - name: Preserve full regression diagnostics
+        if: always()
+        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
+        with:
+          name: sdk-video-regression-evidence
+          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/video-tests.log
+          if-no-files-found: warn
diff --git a/media_kit_video/test/piliplus_view_compat_test.dart b/media_kit_video/test/piliplus_view_compat_test.dart

--- a/media_kit_video/test/piliplus_view_compat_test.dart

@@ -29,7 +29,7 @@ class _Player extends Fake implements Player {
   @override
   final PlayerState state;
   @override
-  final stream = _Streams();
+  final _Streams stream = _Streams();
 }
 
 class _Controller extends Fake implements VideoController {
@@ -128,7 +128,7 @@ void main() {
     )));
     final gesture = tester.widget<GestureDetector>(find.descendant(
       of: find.byType(SubtitleView), matching: find.byType(GestureDetector)));
-    gesture.onVerticalDragUpdate!(DragUpdateDetails(delta: const Offset(0, -500)));
+    gesture.onVerticalDragUpdate!(DragUpdateDetails(delta: const Offset(0, -500), globalPosition: Offset.zero));
     await tester.pump();

diff --git a/tool/piliplus_compat/build_original.py b/tool/piliplus_compat/build_original.py
index 76ceff4..f5cbc7e 100644
--- a/tool/piliplus_compat/build_original.py
+++ b/tool/piliplus_compat/build_original.py
@@ -51,6 +51,7 @@ PLATFORM_MATERIAL = {
 # recorded separately, NOT broadly exempted by extension or directory name.
 GENERATED_TRACKED = frozenset({
     'pubspec.lock', 'pubspec_overrides.yaml',
+    'android/app/src/main/java/io/flutter/plugins/GeneratedPluginRegistrant.java',
     'linux/flutter/generated_plugin_registrant.cc',
     'linux/flutter/generated_plugin_registrant.h',
     'linux/flutter/generated_plugins.cmake',
@@ -91,6 +92,13 @@ def tracked_manifest(root: Path) -> dict:
     return result
 
 
+def symlink_payload(target: str, *, windows: bool) -> bytes:
+    # Windows exposes path separators using its OS spelling. This is a link
+    # representation normalization, not a normalization of ordinary file data.
+    # Absolute/UNC prefixes are retained and cannot match a relative Git blob.
+    return os.fsencode(target.replace('\\', '/') if windows else target)
+
+
 def checked_payload(root: Path, relative: str, mode: str) -> bytes:
     path = root / relative
     # No parent can redirect an original file outside the staged tree.
@@ -102,7 +110,7 @@ def checked_payload(root: Path, relative: str, mode: str) -> bytes:
             raise AuditError(f'Expected source symlink: {relative}')
         if not path.resolve().is_relative_to(root.resolve()):
             raise AuditError(f'Source symlink escaped staging: {relative}')
-        return os.fsencode(os.readlink(path))
+        return symlink_payload(os.readlink(path), windows=os.name == 'nt')
     if not stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode):
         raise AuditError(f'Expected regular source file: {relative}')
     if os.name != 'nt' and bool(info.st_mode & 0o111) != (mode == '100755'):
@@ -118,7 +126,7 @@ def verify_tracked(root: Path, manifest: dict, allowed=frozenset()) -> dict:
             actual = blob_digest(data)
             if actual != record['blob']:
                 if path not in allowed:
-                    violations.append(path)
+                    violations.append(f'{path} (expected {record["blob"]}, actual {actual})')
                 else:
                     generated[path] = {'before': record['blob'], 'after': actual}
         except (OSError, AuditError) as error:
diff --git a/tool/piliplus_compat/test_build_original.py b/tool/piliplus_compat/test_build_original.py
index 9680100..995614b 100644
--- a/tool/piliplus_compat/test_build_original.py
+++ b/tool/piliplus_compat/test_build_original.py
@@ -148,6 +148,22 @@ class BuildGuardTests(unittest.TestCase):
         with self.assertRaises(build.AuditError):
             build.resolution_roots(file)
 
+    def test_windows_symlink_separator_representation(self):
+        self.assertEqual(build.symlink_payload(r'..\common\a.swift', windows=True),
+                         b'../common/a.swift')
+        self.assertEqual(build.symlink_payload(r'..\common\a.swift', windows=False),
+                         b'..\\common\\a.swift')
+        self.assertNotEqual(build.symlink_payload(r'C:\common\a.swift', windows=True),
+                            b'../common/a.swift')
+
+    def test_generated_android_registration_is_an_exact_exception(self):
+        self.write('android/app/src/main/java/io/flutter/plugins/GeneratedPluginRegistrant.java',
+                   '// Generated file. Do not edit.\n')
+        self.assertEqual(build.verify_added(self.root, app=True)['generatedFileCount'], 1)
+        self.write('android/app/src/main/java/io/flutter/plugins/NotGenerated.java', 'class Foreign {}')
+        with self.assertRaises(build.AuditError):
+            build.verify_added(self.root, app=True)
+
     def test_runner_persists_failure_and_actual_exit(self):
         out = self.base / 'output'
         out.mkdir()
